item.title: Follow live: Jordan Love finds Matthew Golden for TD as Packers strike first
item.dc:creator: NFL Nation

item.title: Rodgers throws two TDs to tie Peyton on all-time list, lifts Steelers to OT win
item.description: Aaron Rodgers tied Peyton Manning on the all-time passing touchdown list with 539 in the Steelers' overtime victory.

item.title: Gardner-Johnson ejected from Bills' win after apparent spitting incident
item.description: With his team leading 13-10 at the time, Buffalo Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson was ejected from Sunday's 33-30 victory over Las Vegas following an altercation in the final minute of the first half, when he appeared to spit in the Raiders' direction.
item.dc:creator: Nick Suss

item.title: Panthers' Tremble admits TD taunt was payback for 'suplex' by Eagles' DeJean
item.description: Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble apologized for costing his team a penalty after he taunted defensive back Cooper DeJean, saying it was retaliation for an earlier personal foul.
item.dc:creator: Mike Kaye

item.title: Williams shows no rust in return from injury for Bears: 'I just let it rip'
item.description: Caleb Williams completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a TD and showed no physical limitations from the injury he suffered Sept. 20.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Cronin

item.title: Giants' QB and RB situations left unsettled after home loss to Saints
item.description: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Sunday he's not ready to name a starting quarterback for Week 7 after J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston against the Saints.
item.dc:creator: Jordan Raanan

item.title: Brown has career-high 3 drops in Pats return: 'I'm much better than what I put on display'
item.description: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown, coming off a right high ankle sprain that sidelined him four weeks, had a shaky return to action Sunday, dropping a career-high three passes in the team's win over the Jets
item.dc:creator: Mike Reiss

item.title: Jeudy, amid trade buzz, has clutch catch in Browns' win, gets game ball
item.description: Browns wide receiver Jerry Jeudy had a clutch catch in Cleveland's game-winning drive Sunday, earning a game ball from coach Todd Monken.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Oyefusi
